theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (y : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ β y → exteriorDerivative (fun z => ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (β z) z) y + ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft (exteriorDerivative β y) y = ((m : ℝ) + 1) • β y + fderiv ℝ β y y
